claims.explanation: Methylprednisolone kills cells through glucocorticoid receptor (NR3C1)-mediated apoptosis, which requires intact NR3C1 signaling and is independent of p53. Selectivity is therefore driven by NR3C1 expression/activity and by downstream apoptotic competence rather than by TP53 status, explaining why TP53-mutant lines appear on both sensitive and resistant lists.
